messages:
niko.r: hey all, quick onboarding questions before i start monday: 1) i'm eligible for a tax treaty with my home country--does redwood honor treaty exemptions? 2) PTO accrual for mid-month starts? 3) 401(k) auto-enroll timeline?

marta.hr: welcome Niko! :wave: short answers: 1) we can apply tax treaty benefits but you must submit Form W-8BEN (if applicable) and treaty docs to payroll prior to first pay run. 2) PTO is prorated from your start date; you'll see a prorated balance in Rippling day 1. 3) 401(k) auto-enroll normally applies after 30 days of service (check plan doc); you can opt out in Rippling sooner if you prefer.

josh.payroll: add payroll detail: if you provide W-8BEN and supporting docs before payroll cutoff we can apply treaty rates for the first paycheck. otherwise withholding will be standard and we adjust retroactively. please upload docs to the secure payroll folder: https://redwood-secure/payroll-upload

tara.benefits: benefits note: if you start mid-month and enroll within the first 30 days, medical is typically effective the 1st of the next month. dental/vision sometimes allow earlier effective dates depending on carrier. if you need urgent care, message me and we'll explore options.

niko.r: thanks. for W-8BEN, do i need an apostille or just passport + treaty claim? also curious re 401(k): if i opt out now, can i re-enroll later without waiting 30 days?

marta.hr: usually passport + completed W-8BEN is fine; no apostille required for most treaties but we'll confirm based on country. 401(k): you can opt out at any time in Rippling; re-enrolling is allowed and your elections take effect per plan timing but you won't need manager approval.

josh.payroll: FYI tax timeline: treaty docs processed before payroll cutoff (usually 3 business days before pay run). if you can't get docs in time, we'll still run payroll and correct on next cycle. expect any refunds/adjustments to show in 1-2 pay cycles.

hr-bot: checklist created for niko.r tasks: upload W-8BEN + passport, complete W-4/W-8 form selection, enroll benefits if desired. Owner: marta.hr. Due: 2 business days.

niko.r: awesome, i'll upload tonight. one last: holiday schedule pro-rate? starting mid-week, do i get floating holidays pro-rated?

tara.benefits: holidays are granted on a calendar-year basis; if you start mid-year any prorated floating holidays will be reflected in your Rippling balance and HR will confirm. ping me if you want a quick calc and i'll run it.

niko.r: perfect thanks everyone! excited to join :tada:
